visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of fair-skinned hands tearing large pieces of green and white cabbage into a shiny stainless steel bowl. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen with a wooden countertop and a cutting board in the background. (2) The hands continue tearing the inner, tender leaves of the cabbage. A white textual overlay appears, providing culinary advice about leaf selection. (3) Fine white salt is sprinkled over the cabbage leaves. The hands then vigorously shake the bowl to distribute the salt, followed by forceful squeezing and pressing of the leaves to reduce their volume. (4) The scene shifts to the cabbage being shaken inside a large, transparent plastic bag. The cabbage appears wet and slightly wilted from the salting process. (5) A sharp kitchen knife is seen slicing red chili peppers into thin rings on a yellow cutting board. In the background, garlic cloves and a stainless steel pitcher are visible. (6) The person uses a peeler to create thin ribbons of a bright orange carrot. These ribbons are then placed in a small pink ceramic bowl with salt and massaged by hand. (7) The salted cabbage is washed in a large orange pot filled with clear water. The hands squeeze out excess water and transfer the cabbage to a metal colander. The carrot ribbons are similarly rinsed. (8) Ingredients for a pickling liquid are poured into a rectangular white container: clear vinegar, white sugar, and salt. The mixture is stirred with a spoon over a heat source until the sugar dissolves. (9) The prepared cabbage, carrot ribbons, sliced chilies, and garlic are layered into glass storage jars. The pickling liquid is poured over the vegetables until they are partially submerged. (10) The jars are sealed with white and black lids. The creator is then shown in a medium shot wearing a pink apron, tasting the final product with chopsticks and expressing joy with a smile and thumbs-up gesture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 高麗菜用手撕成大塊狀. (2) [Subtitle]: 做泡菜，用內層的高麗菜葉會比較嫩，好吃! (外層拿來炒). (3) [Subtitle]: 大約1.2%的鹽來醃漬出水這次準備約1800克的高麗菜. (4) [Subtitle]: 盆子搖晃一下，讓鹽分均勻分佈. (5) [Subtitle]: 手用力往下壓讓體積縮小. (6) [Subtitle]: 稍微抓醃翻動一下. (7) [Subtitle]: 從下面翻動上來讓高麗菜快點出水. (8) [Subtitle]: 如果家裡盆子不夠大，也可以用塑膠袋開口轉一下. (9) [Subtitle]: 像這樣搖晃均勻讓高麗菜均勻沾到鹽分. (10) [Subtitle]: 接下來大約靜置30分鐘左右. (11) [Subtitle]: 切1~2條辣椒. (12) [Subtitle]: 選擇大條的辣椒，不太會辣只有風味. (13) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來去皮備用. (14) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔可以刨成絲也可以用刨皮刀刨成小片狀. (15) [Subtitle]: 大概100克左右. (16) [Subtitle]: 加入一小匙的鹽. (17) [Subtitle]: 抓一抓去除生味. (18) [Subtitle]: 一旁靜置一下. (19) [Subtitle]: 現在高麗菜已經出水了. (20) [Subtitle]: 準備一鍋水(請使用飲用水，不要生水). (21) [Subtitle]: 把高麗菜放入水裡清洗掉鹽份. (22) [Subtitle]: 稍微搓一搓大略擠乾水分，放到過濾網上. (23) [Subtitle]: 如果製作份量比較多中間建議換一盆水清洗. (24) [Subtitle]: 把高麗菜放在網架上瀝乾水分即可. (25) [Subtitle]: 滴到水乾為止... (26) [Subtitle]: 一旁再來洗紅蘿蔔. (27) [Subtitle]: 跟高麗菜一樣清洗掉鹽份. (28) [Subtitle]: 擠乾水分，放一旁備用. (29) [Subtitle]: 接著來準備『糖醋水』. (30) [Subtitle]: 糖醋水：純米醋 400ml 上白糖 250ml 鹽 4克 比例約1:0.6:0.01. (31) [Subtitle]: 用小火加熱，讓糖溶解即可(不要煮滾喔!!). (32) [Subtitle]: 煮到糖溶解就可以了!!. (33) [Subtitle]: 加入200ml的冰水(冰水是為了降溫用). (34) [Subtitle]: 把瀝乾的高麗菜放進來一點紅蘿蔔. (35) [Subtitle]: 接著放入辣椒片、蒜頭. (36) [Subtitle]: 再把高麗菜填滿容器. (37) [Subtitle]: 將剛剛的糖醋水倒進來. (38) [Subtitle]: 大約倒到高麗菜三分之一~二分之一的量. (39) [Subtitle]: 擠壓一下，可以再放入高麗菜. (40) [Subtitle]: 蓋上蓋子，室溫靜置一下. (41) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜會繼續出水. (42) [Subtitle]: 大約過一陣子，湯汁就會變多一些. (43) [Subtitle]: 可以拿起來搖一搖讓上面的高麗菜沾到糖醋水. (44) [Subtitle]: 用湯匙壓一下讓上面的高麗菜浸泡到湯汁. (45) [Subtitle]: 現在就可以把泡菜放到冰箱冷藏入味囉~. (46) [Subtitle]: 大約醃漬3小時其實就可以吃了但醃漬12小時，味道會更入味. (47) [Subtitle]: 經過一個晚上，泡菜更入味了!. (48) [Subtitle]: 好囉~那我我要開動囉~ ❤️❤️. (49) [Variety]: 超級好吃~ ❤️❤️. (50) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：羅潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.
